responsibility: This file implements the engine behind GCC diagnostic fix-it application. It models edited files and lines, tracks per-line edit events so later fix-its can be translated from original to effective columns after earlier changes, applies insert/replace/remove operations including multi-line edits, reconstructs rewritten file contents, and generates unified diff-style output. It also contains selftests for column validation, unreadable files, and multi-fixit interactions. Its responsibility is source-text rewriting and diff generation for diagnostics, not emission of the diagnostics themselves.
same_name_distinction: Contains the concrete implementation behind the edit_context API from gcc/edit-context.h, including internal edited_file/edited_line state, fix-it application mechanics, rewritten-content reconstruction, diff printing, and selftests. The header only declares the public edit_context interface.
